scope: Rendered fit and reconstruction observations; no human acceptance or complete mechanism review.

images.observation: Floor sleeve covers the floor aperture and the supply joins the radiator union. Legacy valve and elbow silhouettes remain coarse; this is fit review, not photoreal acceptance.
Mapped receiver pipe meets the wall escutcheon without a visible open wall gap from this stance. Surface variation and elbow joint are visible; bracket and surrounding room polish remain separate.
Restored cabinet, paired keys, paper and ledger render at the test stance after disk reconstruction. Repetitive wood grain and sparse surrounding furnishings remain artistic limitations.

Final native render shows the hanger band seated around the pipe and joined to the support stem. The close crop establishes band contact only; the floor attachment is outside this frame. Iron surface remains visually coarse at this magnification.
